title: Homochiral Cu6Dy3 single-molecule magnets displaying proton conduction and a strong magneto-optical Faraday effect

synthesis.procedure: 0.125 mmol Dy(NO3)3·5H2O was added to 0.25 mmol R,R-H2LSchiff in 20 mL MeOH; after stirring for 15 min, 0.25 mmol Cu(ClO4)2·6H2O and 0.75 mmol Et3N were added in turn. Blue-gray precipitates appeared quickly; 20 mL CH2Cl2 was added to dissolve them. After stirring for 24 h at room temperature a dark blue solution formed, and dark blue crystals of R-1 were grown by slow solvent evaporation. After several days the product was collected by filtration. High-quality crystals could be obtained by recrystallization from MeOH–CH2Cl2 (v/v 1/1).
synthesis.time: stir 15 min, then 24 h; crystals after several days of evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: room-temperature stirring followed by slow evaporation; recrystallization from MeOH–CH2Cl2 (v/v 1/1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: precipitates dissolved with CH2Cl2; dark blue crystals grown by slow evaporation, collected by filtration, optionally recrystallized from MeOH–CH2Cl2 (1/1)

properties.summary: Zero-field Cu6Dy3 SMM: χT = 44.68 cm3 K mol−1 at RT (calc. 44.76), falling to 15.74 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; no hysteresis at 1.9 K. Arrhenius fit of ac relaxation gives Ueff/k = 19.5(0.6) K and τ0 = 4.1(0.1)×10−8 s; φ = 0.25; Cole–Cole α = 0.119–0.222. Enantiomeric CD (mirror-image peaks at 270, 316, 398, ~572 nm in MeCN) and strong magneto-optical Faraday effect with gmax(MCD) = +0.58 T−1.

synthesis.procedure: Same procedure as R-1 using S,S-H2LSchiff in place of the R ligand: 0.125 mmol Dy(NO3)3·5H2O added to 0.25 mmol S,S-H2LSchiff in 20 mL MeOH; after 15 min stirring, 0.25 mmol Cu(ClO4)2·6H2O and 0.75 mmol Et3N were added. Precipitates were dissolved with 20 mL CH2Cl2, the mixture was stirred 24 h at room temperature, and dark blue crystals of S-1 were grown by slow evaporation, collected by filtration, and optionally recrystallized from MeOH–CH2Cl2 (v/v 1/1).

properties.summary: Zero-field Cu6Dy3 SMM enantiomer of R-1: χT = 44.70 cm3 K mol−1 at RT, 16.06 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; no hysteresis at 1.9 K. Ueff/k = 21.4(0.4) K, τ0 = 2.7(0.1)×10−8 s (slightly higher barrier than R-1, attributed to different lattice MeOH/H2O); φ = 0.22; Cole–Cole α = 0.115–0.249. Mirror-image CD versus R-1 and gmax(MCD) = −0.58 T−1, indicating a strong magneto-optical Faraday effect.
